references.role: Original centered camel and rider as identity/style reference; neighboring fragments ignored.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent animation sprite atlas for Crown & Kingdoms, hand-painted medieval isometric RTS. Reference is identity/style only: retain the main mounted warrior, ignore ALL neighboring fragments/background. 1536x1024 landscape, strict 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly sixteen full mounted figures, one complete camel AND rider connected in every cell. Same fixed 3/4 isometric view facing right, realistic painted textures, upper-left warm daylight, consistent proportions/person/materials. Actual transparent background, no grid, labels or terrain. Generous empty margins inside each cell; ALL four camel hooves, camel head/tail, rider head and entire weapon inside each cell, no overlapping figures. A camel is a tan single-humped dromedary with long curved neck, padded feet and camel knees, never a horse. Blue team cloth on rider/saddle supports recolouring; natural camel fur/leather/steel stay neutral. Top two rows frames0-7: eight sequential visibly distinct camel walking/trotting strides with alternating fore/hind legs, planted and lifted feet, correct joints and rider weight. Bottom two rows frames8-15: eight weapon action poses while camel stays planted, frame8 ready idle, frames9-11 wind-up/aim, frame12 impact/release, frames13-15 recovery, then loop. All anatomy intact, no extra limbs, detached rider, floating weapon or airborne projectiles. Tiny transparent foot shadow. Body height about 200px per cell, readable at 60 gameplay pixels. No pixel art, icons, modern equipment, text or background figures. Character: original Camel Rider identity from reference: tan single-humped camel, simple brown leather tack, blue/red saddle blanket, armoured warm-skinned male rider in tan/cream clothing and light mail, small rounded bronze/steel cap, vivid blue cloak, leather boots. Rider carries one long straight spear/lance with a SINGLE steel spearhead. Walking holds lance diagonally with both rider and camel complete. Action is a controlled mounted spear thrust toward the right, frame12 maximum forward extension while retaining a single connected lance in the hand, then pull back and recover. No shield, bow, sword or thrown spear. Keep the spear fully inside each cell even when extended.
